card.name: Book titles in citations and reading lists
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation at the end of or just after a book title in a bibliography or reading list, such as the last title word, a colon, 'by', or an opening bracket before the publisher.

modes.label: Last word of a title
modes.description: The final word of a cited book title, just before the author or publisher.
modes.example: Information Architecture for the World Wide<< Web>>, 2nd Edition.

modes.label: Joiner after a title
modes.description: A colon, 'by', or opening parenthesis right after a title, leading into subtitle, author or publisher.
modes.example: Maybe Yes, Maybe No<< by>> Dan Barker (Prometheus Books,

card.writes: It pushes toward book and publication-related text, away from magazine and book words, so the output looks less like repeating those words.
card.plain: It fires at the edge of a book title in a reference list, where the author or publisher comes next.
